exercises: Fill in the blank. (Items are cheaper today.) 오늘 우유를 ______해요.
Fill in the blank. (You tasted food for free in the store.) ______ 코너에서 김치를 먹어 봤어요.
Fill in both blanks. (You ask a clerk whether you get one free if you buy one. Then you check the date on the package.) 이 요구르트 ______이에요? 아, 그런데 ______이 내일까지네요.

Fill in both blanks. (First you are buying a lot, so you need something with wheels. Then you are buying only milk, so you carry something light in your hand.) 오늘은 살 게 많아요. ______를 가져올게요. 우유만 사요. ______만 들고 가요.
Fill in both blanks. (The line with a cashier is long, so you scan and pay by yourself.) ______에 줄이 너무 길어요. 우리는 ______에서 계산해요.
Fill in both blanks in this conversation at the checkout. 직원: ______ 필요하세요? 손님: 아니요, 괜찮아요. 포인트 ______해 주세요.
objective: Learners can recognize and use 10 key supermarket words (장바구니, 카트, 계산대, 셀프 계산대, 봉투, 할인, 1+1[원 플러스 원], 유통기한, 시식, 적립) in short, natural sentences to find items, check prices and dates, and pay at the checkout. Examples: '봉투 필요 없어요.', '이거 1+1이에요?', '포인트 적립해 주세요.'
summary: Ten everyday words for shopping at a Korean supermarket. Learners pick up a basket or cart, look for sales, 1+1 deals and free samples, check the expiration date, and pay at a regular or self-checkout, saying no to a bag and asking to earn points. The six exercises practice all ten target words.
title: 마트에서 장보기: 꼭 필요한 낱말 10개
